name: JF Technology Berhad
overview: 2026 年 JF Technology 未在公告中披露各业务板块的具体扩张、缩减或合约事项；已披露的公告主要为股息、红股发行、业绩发布及财年变更等公司层面事项。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收 27,403,000 MYR，同比 113.0%；净利润 4,836,000 MYR，同比 436.7%。
overview_en: In 2026, JF Technology did not disclose specific expansion, reduction, or contract events for its business segments in the announcements; the announcements disclosed were mainly corporate-level matters such as dividends, bonus issues, results releases, and financial year end change. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 27,403,000, up 113.0% YoY; net profit was MYR 4,836,000, up 436.7% YoY.
